methods.label: Preserve side lengths
methods.explanation: A translation preserves the shape and size of a figure. Thus, \(\triangle DEF\cong\triangle ABC\), and the perimeter is \(5+6+7=18\text{ cm}\).
methods.levelReason: The reasoning uses grade-7 translation invariance and elementary perimeter addition. The congruence notation expresses the preserved shape and size without requiring a triangle congruence test.

needsNewNodes.name: Perimeter of a polygon
needsNewNodes.description: The perimeter of a polygon is the sum of the lengths of all its sides, counted once around its boundary.
needsNewNodes.reason: The method uses the perimeter of a triangle. cnm_p078 focuses on rectangles and squares, while cnm_038 concerns algebraic-expression applications rather than the general perimeter rule.
